name: @singularity/plugin-music-chord-box
description: The chord box: a chord drawn as a tile in its scale degree's colour (the chord-palette tokens), with its Roman numeral in the display serif and its name. rootReading reads a root against its tonic — the major scale in every key, chromatic roots as ♭II ♭III ♯IV ♭VI ♭VII — giving the numeral's number (the colour) and its accidental.
